description: I/O statistics from pg_stat_io (PostgreSQL 16+). Shows read/write operations, I/O times, and buffer cache efficiency by backend type.

url_options.data:
WITH q AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT labels, t, value
FROM prom_irate(('pgwatch_pg_stat_io_read_bytes_mb'), ([['cluster', '=', ${cluster_name:sqlstring}], ['node_name', '=', ${node_name:sqlstring}], ['backend_type', '=', 'total']]),
       (CAST((${__from} - ${__from} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST((${__to} - ${__to} % CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT)) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)), (CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN CAST(CASE WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 7776000000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 86400000.0) * 86400000 WHEN ${__to} - ${__from} >= 604800000 THEN ceil(${__interval_ms} / 3600000.0) * 3600000 ELSE ${__interval_ms} END AS BIGINT) ELSE greatest(${__interval_ms} + 5000, 20000) END AS BIGINT)))
), names AS (SELECT DISTINCT q."labels" FROM q), legend_names AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT row(q."labels") AS __key, 'Read MiB/s' AS __series, CASE WHEN cardinality(q.labels) = 1 THEN map_values(q.labels)[1] ELSE '{' || array_to_string(list_transform(list_sort(map_keys(q.labels)), lambda k: k || '="' || q.labels[k] || '"'), ', ') || '}' END AS label_set FROM names q
), ranked AS (
SELECT *, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY coalesce(label_set, '')) AS __rank FROM legend_names
), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT __key, __series, lpad(CAST(__rank AS VARCHAR), CAST(length(CAST(max(__rank) OVER () AS VARCHAR)) AS INTEGER), '0') AS __sid FROM ranked
)
SELECT CAST(q.t AS BIGINT) AS time, CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE) AS value, n.__series, n.__sid
FROM q JOIN rendered n ON row(q."labels") IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.__key
WHERE q.value IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(CAST(q.value AS DOUBLE))
ORDER BY time
